_note: Hand-written city notes. Cities are matched to the GeoNames list by geonames_name within the region.

cities.name: Rome
cities.summary: Three thousand years of history in one walkable centre: ancient forums, baroque fountains, the Vatican and neighbourhoods built around long lunches.
things_to_do: Walk the Forum and the Colosseum early, before the heat
See the Vatican Museums and St Peter's
Spend an evening eating in Trastevere
Take the train to the ruins of Ostia Antica

cities.name: Bari
cities.summary: A port city on the Adriatic with a tangled old town, a seafront promenade and beaches a short ride away. A good base for the rest of Apulia.
things_to_do: Get lost in Bari Vecchia and watch pasta being made in the street
Swim at Pane e Pomodoro beach
Eat raw seafood at the old port
Take a day trip to Polignano a Mare or Alberobello

cities.name: Florence
cities.summary: The city of the Renaissance, small enough to cross on foot and packed with galleries, churches and workshops.
things_to_do: Book the Uffizi and the Accademia ahead
Climb to Piazzale Michelangelo for sunset
Cross the Ponte Vecchio to the Oltrarno workshops
Take a bus into the Chianti hills

cities.name: Seville
cities.summary: Andalusia's capital: orange trees, tiled courtyards, a vast Gothic cathedral and flamenco late into the night. Summers are extremely hot.
things_to_do: Visit the Alcazar palace gardens
Climb the Giralda tower
Watch flamenco in Triana
Go from bar to bar for tapas

cities.name: Barcelona
cities.summary: A big Mediterranean city with its own architecture, a Gothic core and beaches at the end of the metro line.
things_to_do: See the Sagrada Familia and Park Guell
Wander the Gothic Quarter
Swim at Barceloneta or head up the coast
Eat at the Boqueria and Sant Antoni markets

cities.name: Lisbon
cities.summary: A hilly capital of trams, tiles and river views, with the Atlantic twenty minutes away.
things_to_do: Ride tram 28 through Alfama
Visit the Belem tower and monastery
Watch the sunset from a miradouro
Take the train to Sintra or the beach at Cascais

cities.name: Lagos
cities.summary: A small walled town at the western end of the Algarve, known for sandstone cliffs, sea caves and sheltered coves.
things_to_do: Take a kayak or boat to the Ponta da Piedade caves
Swim at Praia Dona Ana and Praia do Camilo
Walk the cliff-top path
Surf on the west coast at Sagres

cities.name: Athens
cities.summary: The ancient city beneath a loud modern one. The Acropolis is visible from almost everywhere and the coast is a tram ride away.
things_to_do: Climb the Acropolis at opening time
Spend a morning in the Acropolis Museum
Eat in Psyrri and Monastiraki
Take the tram to the beaches of the Athens Riviera

cities.name: Heraklion
cities.summary: Crete's main city and port, with a Venetian harbour and the island's best museum. The palace of Knossos is on its edge.
things_to_do: Visit the palace of Knossos
See the Minoan frescoes in the Archaeological Museum
Walk the Venetian walls and harbour
Use it as a base for beaches and gorges

cities.name: Dubrovnik
cities.summary: A walled city on the Adriatic, almost unchanged in outline since the Middle Ages. Very busy in summer.
things_to_do: Walk the full circuit of the city walls
Take the cable car up Mount Srd
Swim off the rocks at Buza
Take a boat to Lokrum island

cities.name: Bergen
cities.summary: The gateway to the fjords, with a wooden wharf from Hanseatic times and seven hills around it. Bring a raincoat.
things_to_do: See the wooden houses of Bryggen
Ride the funicular up Floyen and walk down
Eat at the fish market
Take a day cruise into the Sognefjord or Hardangerfjord

cities.name: Saint-Malo
cities.summary: A granite walled port on the Channel, famous for some of the largest tides in Europe.
things_to_do: Walk the ramparts around the old town
Cross to Grand Be island at low tide
Eat oysters in nearby Cancale
Take a day trip to Mont-Saint-Michel

cities.name: Istanbul
cities.summary: A city on two continents, layered with Byzantine and Ottoman monuments and held together by ferries on the Bosphorus.
things_to_do: Visit Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque
Cross to Kadikoy by ferry for food
Explore the Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar
See Topkapi Palace and the Basilica Cistern

cities.name: Paris
cities.summary: Wide boulevards, river walks and some of the world's best-known museums, with a different character in every neighbourhood.
things_to_do: Pick one big museum per day: the Louvre or the Musee d'Orsay
Walk the Seine from Notre-Dame to the Eiffel Tower
Climb Montmartre
Take the train to Versailles
